fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan kept its policy rate unchanged at 11% in its monetary policy decision of 30 July 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 31 July 2025 | Monetary Policy Status Quo | Textile Sector Boost | Reko Diq & BIAFO' (YouTube, 2025-07-31)

fact_text: The analyst reads the rate hold as tied to high industrial energy costs: cutting rates would only help if energy costs also fall, and industry had been asking for single-digit rates.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 31 July 2025 | Monetary Policy Status Quo | Textile Sector Boost | Reko Diq & BIAFO' (YouTube, 2025-07-31)

fact_text: Gas for captive gas-fired power plants was set at Rs 3,500 per MMBtu, which the analyst said is pushing those plants toward the national grid.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 31 July 2025 | Monetary Policy Status Quo | Textile Sector Boost | Reko Diq & BIAFO' (YouTube, 2025-07-31)

fact_text: The analyst said companies moving to the national grid still find grid electricity not cheap enough, so industrial energy costs stay high.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 31 July 2025 | Monetary Policy Status Quo | Textile Sector Boost | Reko Diq & BIAFO' (YouTube, 2025-07-31)

fact_text: The analyst expects banks to keep earning higher net interest margins and spreads from existing fixed-rate loans while policy rates stay unchanged.
